lyrics:
[Intro: whistled melody, stomping kick, handclaps, bass]

[Verse 1: relaxed, half spoken, light and dry]
My inbox has a number that I can't pronounce
The roof has got a leak and the cheque might bounce
I wrote it all down on the back of my hand
Then I washed it in the ocean, wasn't that the plan?

[Chorus: whistle answers each line, gang vocals]
Problems can wait till Monday
They'll still be there, they always are
I've got a towel and a cheap guitar
Sun's out, I'm not home
Problems can wait till Monday

[Whistle Hook: whistled melody, claps, bass]

[Verse 2: relaxed, a little quieter]
I used to lie awake and count them like sheep
Turns out they don't get smaller if you don't sleep
There's a kid with a kite and a dog in the sea
And nobody here needs a thing from me

[Chorus: whistle answers each line, gang vocals]
Problems can wait till Monday
They'll still be there, they always are
I've got a towel and a cheap guitar
Sun's out, I'm not home
Problems can wait till Monday

[Bridge: beat drops to claps, voices in a round]
Not now, not now
Later, later
Not now, not now
Later

[Final Chorus: everyone, whistle on top, tambourine]
Problems can wait till Monday
They'll still be there, they always are
I've got a towel and a cheap guitar
Sun's out, I'm not home
Problems can wait till Monday

[Outro: whistle alone, waves, a phone buzzing in a bag]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 140 BPM, 4/4, C major. A light, stomping, sunlit strut. Carefree with a wink.

VOICE: Male tenor, relaxed and conversational, almost speaking the verses with a smile. The chorus is sung in an easy, open voice with friends joining in. The main hook is a clear, tuneful whistle. The bridge is a simple round sung by several voices.

INSTRUMENTS: A human whistle carrying the melody. A stomping kick and handclap beat. A bouncing, melodic bass guitar that is almost a second lead. Light acoustic guitar strums. Tambourine. A soft organ pad. Very little else. Waves and a buzzing phone at the end.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, the whistle over stomp, claps and bass. 0:14 Verse 1. 0:34 Chorus 1. 0:55 Whistle hook. 1:09 Verse 2. 1:29 Chorus 2. 1:50 Bridge, claps and a round. 2:04 Final chorus with whistle and tambourine. 2:25 Outro, the whistle alone with waves and an ignored phone, ending at 2:38.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Early-2020s soundtrack pop: sparse, bright and dry, bass and whistle up front, lots of open air.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The whistle in the first two seconds.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: Verse 2 is the wisdom: he used to count his problems like sheep and found they do not shrink with lost sleep. The phone buzzing unanswered in the bag is the modern detail.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Worry listed, worry set down, an afternoon enjoyed.
